description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An ally within 30 feet drops to half their maximum Hit Points or lower.

Cost 1 Vitae

Reaction — a quick heal Graft applied the instant an ally drops below half HP.

Cut a Field Suture directly onto the triggering ally and apply its effect immediately: they regain Hit Points equal to twice your level. This consumes a prepared healing Graft if you have one available, or 1 Vitae if you do not.

No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This is a reaction sourced from the caster's own class feature that heals a different creature's HP.
